text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Both teams have fought their way through 
the second and third rounds. 
Which team will come out on top in this 
close contest—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Urara-san, blーーock them!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win... I want to keep winning 
together with everyone...!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it! You're not getting throuuuugh!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Semifinals, Match 1. Will Team <New Year Mega Luck Kitaru> 
reach the finals in their very first 
tournament appearance—?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-U-Um, Opera O-san...! L-Left 2-2...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me—Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... This team is so strong! They 
might actually win the whole 
championship?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, everyone! Wonderful! 
We can win this—no, we ARE going to 
win...!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fuku-chan, your voice is so loud! You're 
really fired up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is a huge venue after all!! 
I'm gonna keep projecting my voice at full 
blast, tooーー!!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Those girls are kind of adorable. 
They're trying so hard, I can't help but 
root for them.

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Match over—advancing to the finals is Team 
<New Year Mega Luck Kitaru>!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mgyaaaaah!!! 
W-We-We d-d-did i-i-it, e-everyoooone!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...W-Wait, h-huh? Wh-Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that match earlier was incredible, 
wasn't it~? 
I think I want to go watch their races 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Me too! 
...Wait, didn't something seem a bit off 
just now?

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear?! 
Apparently, the match lineup for this 
afternoon's finals might be changing.

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Huh, why? Is there some kind of trouble?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... everyone... I'm so... sorr... 
*cough*, *hack*, *wheeze*!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, Fuku-chan! You shouldn't try to 
speak~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"There's no need to apologize... On top of 
giving directions, you were constantly 
cheering us on. It must've taken a huge 
toll on you..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"And since we don't have anyone who can 
substitute for Fukukitaru-san... as 
disappointing as it is, should we withdraw 
from the finals...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... It really is all by fauld...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I god so happy from winning thad I god 
carried away... Even though everyone 
worked so hard togedder..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please don't say that... A-And besides, 
you said it yourself, didn't you, 
Fukukitaru-san?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Having fun is what matters most—and we 
got to participate together, so isn't that 
enough...?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just... participating... is enough... you 
say...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I said thad just bardicipading was fine! 
*cough*, *wheeze*, *hack*! 
I definitely! Said thad, bud still!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"As long as we all took part in the karuta 
tournament, whether we won or lost 
wouldn't matter for our luck!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If we all take part and have fun, we'll 
become closer and everyone will be happy! 
That must be what the divine message 
really meant!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Bud... winning really does bake you 
happy, doesn't id?! 
'Having fun is enough' doesn't bean 'you 
don't have to dry your hardest'—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Trying our hardest togedder was whad bade 
it fun...! And just when I finally figured 
thad oud, look ad be..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah, I'm such an idiod, an idiod!! 
I wanted everyone else to ad leasd blay in 
the finals...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If only... if only there was sob-one who 
could subsdidude for beee!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose this is the right moment.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"My friends, what if I told you there is 
one way—and only one— 
to escape this dire predicament? What 
would you say?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Just as Fukukitaru-san said, what we need 
now is an envoy of the goddess of victory, 
Vittoria—in other words, a savior!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Now, at long last, the stage is yours—! 
You're here, aren't you, Ayabe-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...As noisy as ever, I see.
